title: Dumaahi Qaril tan adaf
intro: diini magaalal, caylale muuci naqabut seethed qusba farmo baxactam qemmisse. ta canka, migaq kaak numma saduh sitta ceela maqna luk suge, ken diihay diini qilsak gubat rade wak yuble. Ta rooci miyyak sugteeh, kay sarrimaane yamixxige carbi booxal qiddeyti addat alfimteh sugtem?
clues: Anu inni ummattah fanak saqal sugeeh, dumaahi diini buxaaxil sugte magaalal inni gadda kee raat yimixxige.
Yi kedoodak num inki Yallih farmo yaysixxigem qemmise wak, anu kaa kee kay gicloh addat yan marah, taturte waktih aydaaditte kinnim keenih secse.
anu too numut garaye usuk salaatah diini ceeloh xaqul, bohoy kay qibaadah caylat soolisam faxximtek.
Anu qusba diini tibba haanam, tet kataysis qangor kee silaacitte inkih saduh, giclo abak sugeh yan miroctih fanat suge.
Anu qande luk Badr deqsita arac fan gexe, nanu qunxa butta diggosnam dudnaamal kibal luk suge.
takkay immay too carbi booxal, yi mano gaba kalteh, kee yi raba qado astootik lakal kufrit garuq sinni marah baritto tekke.
